name: Bilijana Popovska
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: ﻿ Naum Centre is a compassionate and professional counselling service dedicated to supporting individuals through life’s challenges. With a background in social work and extensive experience in mental health, trauma, attachment, anxiety, depression, and grief, I understand the complexities of the human experience. Whether you’re navigating loss, struggling with self-doubt, or working through past trauma, I offer a space where you can feel heard, understood, and empowered. I integrate evidence-based therapeutic approaches, including trauma-informed care, narrative therapy, solutions focussed, and cognitive-behavioral strategies, to tailor our sessions to your needs. My approach is client-centred and evidence-based, integrating trauma-informed care, mindfulness, and cognitive-behavioural strategies to help you develop insight, resilience, and self-compassion.

description: G’day, I’m Dr Coby. My work with people is deeply personal, shaped by lived experience and a genuine respect for the complexity of emotional and relational life.

name: Emma Williams
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: Are you sad, stuck, distressed or worried? With a warm, compassionate approach, I work with individuals, couples, families, children & adolescents. I can help you with: - anxiety and depression - grief, loss and trauma - attachment (including ideal parent figure) - conflict that is ongoing and distressing - broken trust and betrayal - sex and intimacy issues - navigating big life decisions - parenting difficulties - navigating ADHD (VAST) and Autism With a Master of Counselling, I have the expertise to support you to find new ways to manage entrenched difficulties.
